name: vue-ensemble
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate one exceptionally polished, realistic desktop web application screenshot, landscape 16:10, high resolution. Product DayOne, a French LOCAL paper-registry transcription and human review workbench. This is a design proposal, not a marketing landing page. All data is entirely synthetic. Visual language: serious editorial information design, compact precise enterprise tool, warm white canvas #F7F8F7, white panels, charcoal text, dark forest teal #174B43 accents, restrained amber only for unresolved documentary fields. Fine 1px gray borders, 6px corner radius, very subtle or no shadows, clean contemporary sans serif, tabular numbers, small consistent outline icons. No gradients, no purple, no huge metric tiles, no giant whitespace, no stock photography, no decorative charts, no medical diagnosis or risk prediction, no external API or WhatsApp connected claim. Render crisp legible FRENCH text. Consistent shell: narrow 200px left sidebar, small DayOne wordmark top, four links 'Vue d’ensemble', 'Relecture', 'Bot local', 'Configuration', active page teal subtle background. Sidebar footer small 'Sur cet ordinateur' and 'Administrateur'. Top thin bar breadcrumb left, discrete outlined badge 'Données fictives' and user initials AD right. UI should feel crafted for hours of concentrated professional work. Flat front-facing screen, no device frame, no perspective, no surroundings. Use fictional codes only, never patient names. Do not show meaningless AI sparkles or invented percentages.
Page Vue d’ensemble active. Main header 'Vue d’ensemble', subtitle 'Priorisez la relecture des registres.' primary right 'Ouvrir la relecture'. Compact horizontal summary strip, four items with separators: '5 dossiers', '5 à relire', '30 champs à confirmer', '0 validé'. Main area 70% width table headed 'Dossiers à relire', search 'Rechercher un code…', filter 'Tous les états'. Columns 'Dossier', 'Origine', 'À confirmer', 'Dernière activité', action. Five realistic synthetic rows D1-6P7WSDG / Bot local / 8 champs / 14:40 / Relire; D1-JS8QSZF / Visite de suivi / 9 champs / 14:40 / Relire; D1-LT7WSWJ / Démonstration / 3 champs / 14:20; D1-ME58YPM / Démonstration / 5 champs; D1-9B7HU6F / Démonstration / 5 champs. Right 30% panel 'Traitement local': 'OCR prêt', 'Poids installés', small operation counts '0 en attente · 1 terminé', subtle link 'Configuration'. Below right narrow 'Activité récente' showing 14:40 Visite liée, 14:40 Champ corrigé, 14:39 OCR terminé — 2 pages. Thin quiet bottom note 'Bot simulé · Aucun service tiers connecté'. Hierarchy emphasizes table and next action, no fake growth charts.
